user.title: Xi'an Water
user.description:
Set up Xi'an Water integration.

If the API is unreachable (e.g. HTTP 502 or a timeout), the integration automatically falls back to a local JSON file: `xian_water_<client_code>_<cid>_cache.json` or `xian_water_<client_code>.json`. When no usable local JSON exists either, tick "Offline add (skip API check)" below to add the integration anyway.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect: the API is unreachable and no usable local JSON was found. Tick "Offline add (skip API check)" and submit again.

init.title: Xi'an Water Options
init.description: Calibration corrects the estimates: enter the **actual balance** on a given date (from the water utility app / meter). The integration back-calculates the real daily consumption since the last recharge and re-derives the daily estimated cost, remaining days, daily average and cumulative usage. Leave empty to disable calibration.

data.calibration_amount: Calibration amount (actual balance on that date, CNY)
